channel.title: Abdul Manan - Blog
channel.description: Web development, design, SEO and learning to code - by Abdul Manan.

item.title: Bulwark — An MCP and AI Agent Security Scanner
item.description: Nothing in your stack reads the file that decides what your AI agent can do. Bulwark scans MCP servers for prompt injection and tool poisoning.

item.title: ToolForge — 93 Browser Tools, Zero Uploads
item.description: Most free PDF tools upload your file to someone else's server. ToolForge does the whole job inside your browser tab, and works offline.

item.title: CV Studio — A Free, Private Resume Builder
item.description: 12 templates, live A4 pagination and PDF export, with no account and no server. Your CV never leaves the browser.

item.title: LeadSlicer — Split and Clean CSV Files Offline
item.description: Dedupe, filter and split 50,000-row CSV or Excel lead files into chunks, entirely in the browser, with nothing uploaded anywhere.

item.title: SafeRoute — A Full-Stack App on React and Supabase
item.description: Real driving routes, safety scoring, live GPS and a ride marketplace, built on React 19, Supabase RLS and free APIs that need no keys.

item.title: InvoiceApp — Offline Invoicing and Stock Control
item.description: Invoices, quotations, inventory, payments and returns in one local SQLite file. No server, no internet, no subscription.

item.title: LanCall — WebRTC Voice Calls Over Your LAN
item.description: Voice calls between devices on the same network with no cloud service in the middle. A small Python server does the introductions.

item.title: From Figma to Code — My Design Workflow
item.description: How I go from a blank Figma canvas to a working, responsive website — the decisions, the handoff, and the details that make it feel finished.

item.title: 10 JavaScript Tips Every Beginner Should Know
item.description: Small habits that made my JavaScript cleaner and less buggy — from const-by-default to guard clauses and optional chaining.

item.title: SEO for Developers — How I Get Pages to Rank
item.description: Search engine optimization isn't magic. It's clean HTML, fast pages, good metadata and structured data. Here's the practical checklist I use.

item.title: Responsive Web Design — One Site, Every Screen
item.description: How I make websites that look right on a 360px phone and a 4K monitor, using fluid layouts, sensible breakpoints and a mobile-first mindset.

item.title: How I Built This Portfolio
item.description: A behind-the-scenes look at building a fast, GitHub-driven portfolio with zero build step — projects and blog posts that update themselves.

item.title: Clean, Minimal Web Design — Less but Better
item.description: Minimalism isn't about empty pages. It's about removing everything that isn't doing a job, so the things that matter can breathe.

item.title: Learning Web Development as a Student
item.description: What actually helped me learn to build for the web — and what turned out to be a waste of time. An honest note from someone still learning.
